name: Elika
title: One of David's Mighty Warriors
summary: Elika from Harod was one of King David's thirty mighty warriors, known as 'the Thirty.' He is mentioned in the list of David's heroes in 2 Samuel. Although little is known about his individual feats, he was part of that elite group of warriors who served David with great bravery and loyalty.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: Elika from Harod is listed in the roster of David's thirty mighty warriors, an elite group of soldiers who distinguished themselves in service to the king.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's Elite Force
keyEvents.description: David's Mighty Men were a group of warriors who followed David from his early days and throughout his reign, performing courageous feats in battle.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Harod
keyEvents.description: Elika came from Harod, a place that was also the home of another of David's heroes, Shamma. Harod is known from the time of Gideon as a location near the Jezreel Valley.

keyEvents.title: David's Warriors Gather
keyEvents.description: David's Mighty Men represented the core of his military strength, and their loyalty and bravery were crucial to the establishment and defense of the united kingdom of Israel.
